Class.name: IHC.EAI.KPI.Schema.ComponentCount
Class.Description: Class that stores a snaphsot of data required for KPI generation/mgt reports

Index.name: iValueDate
Index.Description: Index of the date this value is for

Query.name: MonthlyCompByApp
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT cc1.Application, YEAR(cc1.ValueDate), MONTH(cc1.ValueDate), SUM(cc1.Value) FROM IHC_EAI_KPI_Schema.ComponentCount cc1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IHC_EAI_KPI_Schema.ComponentCount cc2 WHERE cc2.ValueDate > cc1.ValueDate AND MONTH(cc2.ValueDate) = MONTH(cc1.ValueDate) AND YEAR(cc2.ValueDate) = YEAR(cc1.ValueDate)) AND cc1.Type = 'Total' GROUP BY cc1.Application,cc1.ValueDate ORDER BY cc1.ValueDate
